scores.visual_critic_note: Coherent dark theme with consistent accent color and clear panel structure, but the network graph is too dense to read at rendered size and the overall layout feels cramped with insufficient breathing room between panels.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: All size encodings correctly use scaleSqrt (nodes and color scatter), bar chart baseline starts at zero with data-driven domain, monthly bins are data-driven, but filtered network recalculates rScale domain from the subset causing node sizes to rescale on brush — a mild subset-relation violation.
scores.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag pattern correctly coalesces brush/filter updates into single-frame renders and pointer events avoid mouse-touch fights, but brush scale closures (x, y) are captured once at init with no resize handler, so brushing yields geometrically incorrect coordinates after the panel is resized.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Four cross-linked views (timeline, force network, color scatter, block list) form a coherent crossfilter — manageable conceptually — but the 60-node co-occurrence network is visually dense and the color-scatter panel encodes actual hex colors as dots, creating a visually busy quadrant that slows parsing; animation/interaction quality cannot be assessed from the static screenshot.
